title: sorbus aria
intro: Sorbus aria, commonly known as the whitebeam, is a deciduous shrub or small tree in the rose family (Rosaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and anti-tyrosinase activities, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and skin conditions like hyperpigmentation. The health benefits of Sorbus aria may also include its potential to support cardiovascular health and reduce inflammation, although further research is needed to confirm these effects.
